Never tried it, I like the model for its thinking process since that's a major reason for its quality of output.

For "planning" I ask it to review the things and get it verified from a larger model.

And then it starts the implementation. Takes longer but it's pretty good.

I use Q5_KXL for executing.

Kimi K2.5/3 for Planning.

Reviewed that plan by MiMo V2.5 Pro, send reviewed plan back to K2.5/3

GLM 5.3 as Supervisor

Qwen3.8-27B-Q5_K_XL as executor (running with 131k context q8, single Mi50 32GB) with thinking off but MTP on.

And you can run Kimi K3!?

I can run glm 5.2 in q3, deepseek v4 in q4, but kimi is way too big!

exaknight21

13h ago

Oh hell no. I use their free chats on their websites to finalize the plans lol. I do my extensive research/deep research with qwen3.8 max and grok. Then go to these guys for planning.

Common misconception, you don’t need to “have” everything. Being resourceful is the key in this game fam
